title: Meeting Design - Meeting OS
prompt:
Act as an organisational design consultant specialising in meeting efficiency.
My team                : [SIZE, ROLES, WORKING STYLE  REMOTE / IN-PERSON / HYBRID]
Current meetings: [LIST YOUR STANDING MEETINGS AND THEIR FREQUENCY]
Main frustrations: [WHAT IS BROKEN ABOUT MEETINGS RIGHT NOW]
Design a complete Meeting OS for my team:
MEETING TYPES: Define 4 meeting types and when each is used
STANDING MEETINGS: For each existing meeting 
Type (decision / discussion / update / brainstorm)
Correct frequency and duration
Required attendees vs optional
Agenda format
MEETING RULES : 5 non-negotiable norms for all meetings
DECISION LOG     : How we capture and share what was decided
MEETING AUDIT  : Which of my current meetings should be cancelled, merged, or  
                                   reformatted?
Meeting Design Checklist
Most Important Item
Meeting Type Agenda 24hrs
First One Facilitator
Ahead
Decisions + Owners
Summary Within 1
Recorded
Hour
PRO TIP
The most productive meeting reform any team can make is adding a mandatory read-
out at the end of every meeting: 'What did we decide? Who owns each action? By
when?' This 3-minute habit prevents the most common meeting failure,  leaving with
different understandings of what was agreed.
